name: Aura
description: Enables users to search company databases, analyze employee headcount trends, track hiring and attrition rates, explore corporate structures, and benchmark workforce metrics across industries

_published_faq.name: How do I add Aura to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Aura to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.auraintelligence.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Aura MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aura provides these MCP tools: find_companies, get_company_subsidiaries, get_monthly_headcount, analyze_employee_growth, breakdown_by_job_function, and analyze_seniority_levels.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Aura?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Aura in data on the Manufact MCP catalog include Clarivate IPOne CompuMark Trademarks, Enterpret, Motion Creative Analytics, Nimble, and Origin.
Aura requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Aura is developed by Aura Intelligence. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
